title: NeuralTrust, which offers tech that lets enterprises discover, monitor, govern, and secure AI agents, raised a $20M seed led by Alstin Capital (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
summary: Tamara Djurickovic / Tech.eu: NeuralTrust, which offers tech that lets enterprises discover, monitor, govern, and secure AI agents, raised a $20M seed led by Alstin Capital — NeuralTrust plans to use the new capital to strengthen its platform, hire additional engineers, and expand its presence across the European market.
